name: Archaeological Ensemble of Tarraco
description: Beneath the modern streets of Tarragona, on Spain's Catalan coast, lie the remains of Tarraco, the oldest Roman settlement on the Iberian Peninsula and later capital of Hispania Tarraconensis. It was also the centre of emperor worship for the Iberian provinces. Though much is fragmentary and tucked under later buildings, the excavated ruins still reveal the grandeur of a Roman provincial capital.
